newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt police arrest 65 workers for demonstration.
newsitem.headline: Egypt police arrest 65 workers for demonstration.

text.p: Egyptian police arrested 65 workers who allegedly led a demonstration of 300 disgruntled workers in the eastern province of Ismailia, security sources said on Monday.
They said the demonstration took place on Sunday after a rumour spread that the Salheya Company for Land Reclamation would fire several workers and reduce the wages of others.
The detained workers are expected to appear before prosecutors soon, the sources said.
Salheya Company for Land Reclamation made some workers redundant after it was privatised six months ago, the sources said.
